svg.title: HRIS automation workflow architecture
svg.desc: A hire, rehire, or offboard event in Zoho People reaches the provisioning API (Node.js, TypeScript) by webhook. The API enqueues the job in BullMQ on Redis, and workers run it, skipping any account that already exists. Workers create or remove accounts in 8 tools: JumpCloud, Zoho, Slack, Confluence, Jira, Bitbucket, Datadog, and Tailscale. A failed job goes back to the queue to retry with backoff and resumes at the failed step. Workers record every change in a MySQL audit log.
